## Goal

Expose the generalised unlock state to the renderer through an additive, total context-bridge surface, keeping the existing `steamFollow` surface working.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Generalised action-reward IPC channels plus a total read API (`isUnlocked(target)`, `getUnlocks()`) are defined; every handler returns a safe value and never throws.
- `electron/preload.cjs` exposes an additive `window.tce.contentUnlocks`; `window.tce.steamFollow` and all `steamFollow:*` channels remain unchanged.
- `src/ui/content-unlock-client.ts` is a total read client that returns "not unlocked" with no Electron bridge (plain browser) and never throws.
- Tests cover handler totality and the browser-fallback client, and confirm the existing steam-follow IPC/client tests still pass; all pass under `--project unit`.

## Minimal Implementation

- Generalise `electron/steam-follow-ipc.ts` into action-reward handlers (or add a parallel `electron/action-rewards-ipc.ts`), keeping `steamFollow:*` registered.
- Add `contentUnlocks` to `electron/preload.cjs`.
- New `src/ui/content-unlock-client.ts`.

## Key Files

- `electron/action-rewards-ipc.ts` — **new/generalised**: total handler table.
- `electron/preload.cjs` — additive `contentUnlocks` bridge.
- `src/ui/content-unlock-client.ts` — **new**: total read client + browser fallback.
- `tests/platform-action-rewards/action-rewards-ipc.test.ts` — **new**.
- `tests/steam-follow/steam-follow-ipc.test.ts` — must remain green.

## Deliverables

Generalised IPC + preload + renderer client + tests.

## Dependencies

- Generalised action-reward service and unified target-keyed persistence (F3).

## Test Plan

`npx vitest run --project unit tests/platform-action-rewards/ tests/steam-follow/`

## Goal

Generalise the Game Selector lock computation so launcher lock state and in-game DLC checks consume the same unlock state, for game and DLC targets.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` is generalised to consume follow status plus action-reward status for game targets and exposes a DLC-target check; no-catalog/browser mode locks nothing so the web build stays fully playable.
- The Game Selector renders locked/unlocked consistently with the in-game DLC check for the same target — one source of truth.
- Unit tests cover game lock/unlock, a DLC target, the unavailable case, and the no-catalog browser no-op; the existing steam-lock tests still pass and all pass under `--project unit`.

## Minimal Implementation

- Generalise `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` (pure) to take the unified unlock state and evaluate game + DLC targets.
- Wire it where the selector builds its game list (or keep the pure computation and assert consistency in tests).

## Key Files

- `src/ui/steam-lock.ts` — generalised lock computation.
- `src/ui/GameSelectorScene.ts` — consumes locks for game entries.
- `tests/ui/steam-lock.test.ts` — extended.
- `src/ui/content-unlock-client.ts` — read source for the generalised state.

## Deliverables

Generalised lock computation + tests.

## Dependencies

- Action-reward config and drift validator (F4).
- Generalised IPC/preload bridge and total read API (F5).

## Test Plan

`npx vitest run --project unit tests/ui/`

data.description:
## Goal

Add a pure, framework-free DLC gate helper that any game uses to gate content on the unified unlock state, and prove it end-to-end with a Gym scene whose content is unreachable until the action is verified. Proof target: Gym scene only (producer decision); per-game roll-out is follow-up work.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A pure helper (`src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` or equivalent) gates content on `isUnlocked({ kind: 'dlc', gameId, dlcId })`.
- An unknown, unreadable, or absent unlock state degrades to "not unlocked" and never crashes the owning game.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymDlcUnlockScene.ts` demonstrates a DLC content item that is locked until verified, then reachable, with a documented locked-state presentation.
- A unit test covers the gate helper; a browser/Gym test covers the gated-content UI (locked → verified → reachable); tests pass under their projects.

## Minimal Implementation

- New pure `src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` (no Phaser/Electron dependency; takes an unlock-check function).
- New Gym scene using SLL and the existing Gym scene base, consuming the F5 read client.
- Locked-state presentation documented in the scene help text.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/DlcGate.ts` — **new**: pure DLC unlock gate.
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymDlcUnlockScene.ts` — **new**: proof scene.
- `tests/core-engine/DlcGate.test.ts` — **new**.
- `tests/gym/GymDlcUnlock.browser.test.ts` — **new**.

## Deliverables

Gate helper + Gym proof scene + unit/browser tests.

## Dependencies

- Generalised IPC/preload bridge and total read API (F5).

## Test Plan

`npx vitest run --project unit tests/core-engine/DlcGate.test.ts` and `npx vitest run --project browser tests/gym/GymDlcUnlock.browser.test.ts`
